1.text: Now it happened in tha days of Ahasuerus, (dis is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even 2 Ethiopia, over an hundred N seven N twenty provinces:)
Dat in dose days, when tha king Ahasuerus sat on tha throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan tha palace,
In tha third year of his reign, he made a feast 2 all his princes N his servants; tha power of Persia N Media, tha nobles N princes of tha provinces, bein before him:
When he showed tha riches of his glorious kingdom N tha honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred N fourscore days.
N when dese days were expired, tha king made a feast 2 all tha people dat were present in Shushan tha palace, both 2 great N small, seven days, in tha court of tha garden of tha king’s palace;

Where were white, green, N blue, hangings, fastened wit cords of fine linen N purple 2 silver rings N pillars of marble: tha beds were of gold N silver, upon a pavement of red, N blue, N white, N black, marble.
N dey gave ’em drink in vessels of gold, (tha vessels bein diverse one from another,) N royal wine in abundance, according 2 tha state of tha king.
N tha drinkin was according 2 tha law; none did compel: 4 so tha king had appointed 2 all tha officers of his house, dat dey should do according 2 every man’s pleasure.
Also Vashti tha queen made a feast 4 tha women in tha royal house which belonged 2 king Ahasuerus.

On tha seventh day, when tha heart of tha king was merry wit wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, N Abagtha, Zethar, N Carcas, tha seven chamberlains dat served in tha presence of Ahasuerus tha king,
2 bring Vashti tha queen before tha king wit tha crown royal, 2 show tha people N tha princes her beauty: 4 she was fair 2 look on.
But tha queen Vashti refused 2 come at tha king’s commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was tha king very angry, N his anger burned in him.
Then tha king said 2 tha wise men, which knew tha times, (4 so was tha king’s manner toward all dat knew law N judgment:
N tha next 2 him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, N Memucan, tha seven princes of Persia N Media, which saw tha king’s face, N which sat tha first in tha kingdom;)
What shall we do 2 tha queen Vashti according 2 law, because she has not performed tha commandment of tha king Ahasuerus by tha chamberlains?
N Memucan answered before tha king N tha princes, Vashti tha queen has not done wrong 2 tha king only, but also 2 all tha princes, N 2 all tha people dat r in all tha provinces of tha king Ahasuerus.

4 dis deed of tha queen shall come abroad 2 all women, so dat dey shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, tha king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti tha queen 2 be brought in before him, but she came not.
Likewise shall tha ladies of Persia N Media say dis day 2 all tha king’s princes, which have heard of tha deed of tha queen. like dis shall there arise too much contempt N wrath.

If it please tha king, let there go a royal commandment from him, N let it be written among tha laws of tha Persians N tha Medes, dat it don’t be altered, dat Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; N let tha king give her royal estate 2 another dat is better than she.
N when tha king’s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (4 it is great,) all tha wives shall give 2 their husbands honour, both 2 great N small.
N tha sayin pleased tha king N tha princes; N tha king did according 2 tha word of Memucan:

4 he sent letters in2 all tha king’s provinces, in2 every province according 2 tha writing of it, N 2 every people after their language, dat every man should bear rule in his own house, N dat it should be published according 2 tha language of every people.

2.text: After dese things, when tha wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, N what she had done, N what was decreed against her.
Then said tha king’s servants dat ministered 2 him, Let there be fair young virgins sought 4 tha king:

N let tha king appoint officers in all tha provinces of his kingdom, dat dey may gather together all tha fair young virgins 2 Shushan tha palace, 2 tha house of tha women, 2 tha custody of Hege tha king’s chamberlain, keeper of tha women; N let their things 4 purification be given ’em:
N let tha maiden which pleaseth tha king be queen instead of Vashti. N tha thing pleased tha king; N he did so.
Now in Shushan tha palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, tha son of Jair, tha son of Shimei, tha son of Kish, a Benjamite;
Who had been carried away from Jerusalem wit tha captivity which had been carried away wit Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar tha king of Babylon had carried away.

N he brought up Hadassah, dat is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter: 4 she had neither father nor mother, N tha maid was fair N beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father N mother were dead, took 4 his own daughter.

So it happened, when tha king’s commandment N his decree was heard, N when many maidens were gathered together 2 Shushan tha palace, 2 tha custody of Hegai, dat Esther was brought also 2 tha king’s house, 2 tha custody of Hegai, keeper of tha women.

N tha maiden pleased him, N she obtained kindness of him; N he speedily gave her her things 4 purification, wit such things as belonged 2 her, N seven maidens, which were meet 2 be given her, out of tha king’s house: N he preferred her N her maids 2 tha best place of tha house of tha women.
Esther had not showed her people nor her kindred: 4 Mordecai had charged her dat she should not show it.
N Mordecai walked every day before tha court of tha women’s house, 2 know how Esther did, N what should become of her.

Now when every maid’s turn was come 2 go in 2 king Ahasuerus, after dat she had been twelve months, according 2 tha manner of tha women, (4 so were tha days of their purifications accomplished, 2 wit, six months wit oil of myrrh, N six months wit sweet odours, N wit other things 4 tha purifying of tha women;)
Then like dis came every maiden 2 tha king; whatever she desired was given her 2 go wit her out of tha house of tha women 2 tha king’s house.

In tha evening she went, N on tha morrow she returned in2 tha second house of tha women, 2 tha custody of Shaashgaz, tha king’s chamberlain, which kept tha concubines: she came in 2 tha king no more, except tha king delighted in her, N dat she were called by name.

Now when tha turn of Esther, tha daughter of Abihail tha uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her 4 his daughter, was come 2 go in 2 tha king, she required nothing but what Hegai tha king’s chamberlain, tha keeper of tha women, appointed. N Esther obtained favour in tha sight of all ’em dat looked upon her.
So Esther was taken 2 king Ahasuerus in2 his house royal in tha tenth month, which is tha month Tebeth, in tha seventh year of his reign.
N tha king loved Esther above all tha women, N she obtained grace N favour in his sight more than all tha virgins; so dat he set tha royal crown upon her head, N made her queen instead of Vashti.
Then tha king made a great feast 2 all his princes N his servants, even Esther’s feast; N he made a release 2 tha provinces, N gave gifts, according 2 tha state of tha king.
N when tha virgins were gathered together tha second time, then Mordecai sat in tha king’s gate.
Esther had not yet showed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: 4 Esther did tha commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up wit him.
In dose days, while Mordecai sat in tha king’s gate, two of tha king’s chamberlains, Bigthan N Teresh, of dose which kept tha door, were angry, N sought 2 lay hand on tha king Ahasuerus.
N tha thing was known 2 Mordecai, who told it 2 Esther tha queen; N Esther certified tha king of it in Mordecai’s name.
N when inquisition was made of tha matter, it was found out; therefore dey were both hanged on a tree: N it was written in tha book of tha chronicles before tha king.

3.text: After dese things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman tha son of Hammedatha tha Agagite, N advanced him, N set his seat above all tha princes dat were wit him.
N all tha king’s servants, dat were in tha king’s gate, bowed, N reverenced Haman: 4 tha king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.
Then tha king’s servants, which were in tha king’s gate, said 2 Mordecai, Why transgressest u tha king’s commandment?
Now it happened, when dey spoke daily 2 him, N he listened not 2 ’em, dat dey told Haman, 2 see whether Mordecai’s matters would stand: 4 he had told ’em dat he was a Jew.
N when Haman saw dat Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.

N he thought scorn 2 lay hands on Mordecai alone; 4 dey had showed him tha people of Mordecai: so Haman sought 2 destroy all tha Jews dat were throughout tha whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even tha people of Mordecai.

In tha first month, dat is, tha month Nisan, in tha twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, dey cast Pur, dat is, tha lot, before Haman from day 2 day, N from month 2 month, 2 tha twelfth month, dat is, tha month Adar.

N Haman said 2 king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad N dispersed among tha people in all tha provinces of ur kingdom; N their laws r diverse from all people; neither keep dey tha king’s laws: therefore it is not 4 tha king’s profit 2 suffer ’em.

If it please tha king, let it be written dat dey may be destroyed: N I will pay ten thousand talents of silver 2 tha hands of dose dat have tha charge of tha business, 2 bring it in2 tha king’s treasuries.
N tha king took his ring from his hand, N gave it 2 Haman tha son of Hammedatha tha Agagite, tha Jews’ opp.
N tha king said 2 Haman, tha silver is given 2 u, tha people also, 2 do wit ’em as it seems good 2 u.

Then were tha king’s scribes called on tha thirteenth day of tha first month, N there was written according 2 all dat Haman had commanded 2 tha king’s lieutenants, N 2 tha governors dat were over every province, N 2 tha rulers of every people of every province according 2 tha writing of it, N 2 every people after their language; in tha name of king Ahasuerus was it written, N sealed wit tha king’s ring.

N tha letters were sent by posts in2 all tha king’s provinces, 2 destroy, 2 kill, N 2 cause 2 perish, all Jews, both young N old, little children N women, in one day, even upon tha thirteenth day of tha twelfth month, which is tha month Adar, N 2 take tha spoil of ’em 4 a prey.
Tha copy of tha writing 4 a commandment 2 be given in every province was published 2 all people, dat dey should be ready against dat day.
Tha posts went out, bein hastened by tha king’s commandment, N tha decree was given in Shushan tha palace. N tha king N Haman sat down 2 drink; but tha city Shushan was perplexed.

4.text: When Mordecai perceived all dat was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, N put on sackcloth wit ashes, N went out in2 tha midst of tha city, N cried wit a loud N a bitter cry;
N came even before tha king’s gate: 4 none might enter in2 tha king’s gate clothed wit sackcloth.
N in every province, wherever tha king’s commandment N his decree came, there was great mournin among tha Jews, N fasting, N weepin, N wailing; N many lay in sackcloth N ashes.
So Esther’s maids N her chamberlains came N told it her. Then was tha queen exceedingly grieved; N she sent clothing 2 clothe Mordecai, N 2 take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.
Then called Esther 4 Hatach, one of tha king’s chamberlains, whom he had appointed 2 attend upon her, N gave him a commandment 2 Mordecai, 2 know what it was, N why it was.
So Hatach went forth 2 Mordecai 2 tha street of tha city, which was before tha king’s gate.
N Mordecai told him of all dat had happened 2 him, N of tha sum of tha money dat Haman had promised 2 pay 2 tha king’s treasuries 4 tha Jews, 2 destroy ’em.

Also he gave him tha copy of tha writing of tha decree dat was given at Shushan 2 destroy ’em, 2 show it 2 Esther, N 2 declare it 2 her, N 2 charge her dat she should go in 2 tha king, 2 make supplication 2 him, N 2 make request before him 4 her people.
N Hatach came N told Esther tha words of Mordecai.
Again Esther spoke 2 Hatach, N gave him commandment 2 Mordecai;

All tha king’s servants, N tha people of tha king’s provinces, do know, dat whoever, whether man or woman, shall come 2 tha king in2 tha inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his 2 put him 2 death, except such 2 whom tha king shall hold out tha golden sceptre, dat he may live: but I have not been called 2 come in 2 tha king dese thirty days.
N dey told 2 Mordecai Esther’s words.
Then Mordecai commanded 2 answer Esther, Think not wit urself dat u will escape in tha king’s house, more than all tha Jews.

4 if u altogether hold ur peace at dis time, then shall there enlargement N deliverance arise 2 tha Jews from another place; but u N ur father’s house shall be destroyed: N who knows whether u r come 2 tha kingdom 4 such a time as dis?
Then Esther told ’em return Mordecai dis answer,

Go, gather together all tha Jews dat r present in Shushan, N fast y’all 4 me, N neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also N my maidens will fast likewise; N so will I go in 2 tha king, which is not according 2 tha law: N if I perish, I perish.
So Mordecai went his way, N did according 2 all dat Esther had commanded him.

5.text: Now it happened on tha third day, dat Esther put on her royal clothing, N stood in tha inner court of tha king’s house, over against tha king’s house: N tha king sat upon his royal throne in tha royal house, over against tha gate of tha house.

N it was so, when tha king saw Esther tha queen standin in tha court, dat she obtained favour in his sight: N tha king held out 2 Esther tha golden sceptre dat was in his hand. So Esther drew near, N touched tha top of tha sceptre.
Then said tha king 2 her, What will u, queen Esther? N what is ur request? it shall be even given u 2 tha half of tha kingdom.
N Esther answered, If it seem good 2 tha king, let tha king N Haman come dis day 2 tha banquet dat I have prepared 4 him.
Then tha king said, Cause Haman 2 make haste, dat he may do as Esther has said. So tha king N Haman came 2 tha banquet dat Esther had prepared.
N tha king said 2 Esther at tha banquet of wine, What is ur petition? N it will be granted u: N what is ur request? even 2 tha half of tha kingdom it shall be performed.
Then answered Esther, N said, My petition N my request is;

If I have found favour in tha sight of tha king, N if it please tha king 2 grant my petition, N 2 perform my request, let tha king N Haman come 2 tha banquet dat I shall prepare 4 ’em, N I will do 2 morrow as tha king has said.
Then went Haman forth dat day joyful N wit a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in tha king’s gate, dat he stood not up, nor moved 4 him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: N when he came home, he sent N called 4 his friends, N Zeresh his wife.
N Haman told ’em of tha glory of his riches, N tha crowd of his children, N all tha things in which tha king had promoted him, N how he had advanced him above tha princes N servants of tha king.
Haman said moreover, yeah, Esther tha queen did let no man come in wit tha king 2 tha banquet dat she had prepared but myself; N 2 morrow am I invited 2 her also wit tha king.
Yet all dis availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai tha Jew sittin at tha king’s gate.

Then said Zeresh his wife N all his friends 2 him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, N 2 morrow speak u 2 tha king dat Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go u in merrily wit tha king 2 tha banquet. N tha thing pleased Haman; N he caused tha gallows 2 be made.

6.text: On dat night could not tha king sleep, N he commanded 2 bring tha book of records of tha chronicles; N dey were read before tha king.
N it was found written, dat Mordecai had told of Bigthana N Teresh, two of tha king’s chamberlains, tha keepers of tha door, who sought 2 lay hand on tha king Ahasuerus.
N tha king said, What honour N dignity has been done 2 Mordecai 4 dis? Then said tha king’s servants dat ministered 2 him, There is nothing done 4 him.
N tha king said, Who is in tha court? Now Haman was come in2 tha outward court of tha king’s house, 2 speak 2 tha king 2 hang Mordecai on tha gallows dat he had prepared 4 him.
N tha king’s servants said 2 him, look, Haman stands in tha court. N tha king said, Let him come in.
So Haman came in. N tha king said 2 him, What shall be done 2 tha man whom tha king delights 2 honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, 2 whom would tha king delight 2 do honour more than 2 myself?
N Haman answered tha king, 4 tha man whom tha king delights 2 honour,
Let tha royal clothing be brought which tha king uses 2 wear, N tha horse dat tha king rides upon, N tha crown royal which is set upon his head:

N let dis clothing N horse be delivered 2 tha hand of one of tha king’s most noble princes, dat dey may array tha man withal whom tha king delights 2 honour, N bring him on horseback through tha street of tha city, N proclaim before him, like dis shall it be done 2 tha man whom tha king delights 2 honour.
Then tha king said 2 Haman, Make haste, N take tha clothing N tha horse, as u have said, N do even so 2 Mordecai tha Jew, dat sits at tha king’s gate: let nothing fail of all dat u have spoken.

Then took Haman tha clothing N tha horse, N arrayed Mordecai, N brought him on horseback through tha street of tha city, N proclaimed before him, like dis shall it be done 2 tha man whom tha king delights 2 honour.
N Mordecai came again 2 tha king’s gate. But Haman hasted 2 his house mournin, N havin his head covered.

N Haman told Zeresh his wife N all his friends every thing dat had befallen him. Then said his wise men N Zeresh his wife 2 him, If Mordecai be of tha seed of tha Jews, before whom u have begun 2 fall, u will not prevail against him, but will surely fall before him.
N while dey were yet talking wit him, came tha king’s chamberlains, N hasted 2 bring Haman 2 tha banquet dat Esther had prepared.

7.text: So tha king N Haman came 2 banquet wit Esther tha queen.

N tha king said again 2 Esther on tha second day at tha banquet of wine, What is ur petition, queen Esther? N it will be granted u: N what is ur request? N it will be performed, even 2 tha half of tha kingdom.
Then Esther tha queen answered, If I have found favour in ur sight, O king, N if it please tha king, let my life be given me at my petition, N my people at my request:
4 we r sold, I N my people, 2 be destroyed, 2 be killed, N 2 perish. But if we had been sold 4 bondmen N bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although tha opp could not countervail tha king’s damage.
Then tha king Ahasuerus answered 2 Esther tha queen, Who is he, N where is he, dat dared presume in his heart 2 do so?
N Esther said, tha adversary N opp is dis wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before tha king N tha queen.

N tha king arising from tha banquet of wine in his wrath went in2 tha palace garden: N Haman stood up 2 make request 4 his life 2 Esther tha queen; 4 he saw dat there was evil determined against him by tha king.

Then tha king returned out of tha palace garden in2 tha place of tha banquet of wine; N Haman was fallen upon tha bed whereon Esther was. Then said tha king, Will he force tha queen also before me in tha house? As tha word went out of tha king’s mouth, dey covered Haman’s face.

N Harbonah, one of tha chamberlains, said before tha king, look also, tha gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made 4 Mordecai, who had spoken good 4 tha king, stands in tha house of Haman. Then tha king said, Hang him thereon.
So dey hanged Haman on tha gallows dat he had prepared 4 Mordecai. Then was tha king’s wrath pacified.

8.text: On dat day did tha king Ahasuerus give tha house of Haman tha Jews’ opp 2 Esther tha queen. N Mordecai came before tha king; 4 Esther had told what he was 2 her.
N tha king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, N gave it 2 Mordecai. N Esther set Mordecai over tha house of Haman.
N Esther spoke yet again before tha king, N fell down at his feet, N besought him wit tears 2 put away tha mischief of Haman tha Agagite, N his device dat he had devised against tha Jews.
Then tha king held out tha golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, N stood before tha king,

N said, If it please tha king, N if I have found favour in his sight, N tha thing seem right before tha king, N I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written 2 reverse tha letters devised by Haman tha son of Hammedatha tha Agagite, which he wrote 2 destroy tha Jews which r in all tha king’s provinces:
4 how can I endure 2 see tha evil dat shall come 2 my people? or how can I endure 2 see tha destruction of my kindred?
Then tha king Ahasuerus said 2 Esther tha queen N 2 Mordecai tha Jew, look, I have given Esther tha house of Haman, N him dey have hanged upon tha gallows, because he laid his hand upon tha Jews.
Write y’all also 4 tha Jews, as it liketh u, in tha king’s name, N seal it wit tha king’s ring: 4 tha writing which is written in tha king’s name, N sealed wit tha king’s ring, may no man reverse.

Then were tha king’s scribes called at dat time in tha third month, dat is, tha month Sivan, on tha three N twentieth day of it; N it was written according 2 all dat Mordecai commanded 2 tha Jews, N 2 tha lieutenants, N tha deputies N rulers of tha provinces which r from India 2 Ethiopia, an hundred twenty N seven provinces, 2 every province according 2 tha writing of it, N 2 every people after their language, N 2 tha Jews according 2 their writing, N according 2 their language.
N he wrote in tha king Ahasuerus’ name, N sealed it wit tha king’s ring, N sent letters by posts on horseback, N riders on mules, camels, N young dromedaries:

In which tha king granted tha Jews which were in every city 2 gather themselves together, N 2 stand 4 their life, 2 destroy, 2 kill, N 2 cause 2 perish, all tha power of tha people N province dat would assault ’em, both little ones N women, N 2 take tha spoil of ’em 4 a prey,
Upon one day in all tha provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon tha thirteenth day of tha twelfth month, which is tha month Adar.
Tha copy of tha writing 4 a commandment 2 be given in every province was published 2 all people, N dat tha Jews should be ready against dat day 2 avenge themselves on their opps.
So tha posts dat rode upon mules N camels went out, bein hastened N pressed on by tha king’s commandment. N tha decree was given at Shushan tha palace.
N Mordecai went out from tha presence of tha king in royal clothing of blue N white, N wit a great crown of gold, N wit a garment of fine linen N purple: N tha city of Shushan rejoiced N was glad.
Tha Jews had light, N gladness, N joy, N honour.

N in every province, N in every city, wherever tha king’s commandment N his decree came, tha Jews had joy N gladness, a feast N a good day. N many of tha people of tha land became Jews; 4 tha fear of tha Jews fell upon ’em.

9.text: Now in tha twelfth month, dat is, tha month Adar, on tha thirteenth day of tha same, when tha king’s commandment N his decree drew near 2 be put in execution, in tha day dat tha opps of tha Jews hoped 2 have power over ’em, (though it was turned 2 tha contrary, dat tha Jews had rule over ’em dat hated ’em;)

Tha Jews gathered themselves together in their citiez throughout all tha provinces of tha king Ahasuerus, 2 lay hand on such as sought their hurt: N no man could withstand ’em; 4 tha fear of ’em fell upon all people.
N all tha rulers of tha provinces, N tha lieutenants, N tha deputies, N officers of tha king, helped tha Jews; because tha fear of Mordecai fell upon ’em.
4 Mordecai was great in tha king’s house, N his fame went out throughout all tha provinces: 4 dis man Mordecai grew greater N greater.
Like dis tha Jews struck all their opps wit tha stroke of tha sword, N slaughter, N destruction, N did what dey would 2 dose dat hated ’em.
N in Shushan tha palace tha Jews killed N destroyed five hundred men.
N Parshandatha, N Dalphon, N Aspatha,
N Poratha, N Adalia, N Aridatha,
N Parmashta, N Arisai, N Aridai, N Vajezatha,
Tha ten sons of Haman tha son of Hammedatha, tha opp of tha Jews, killed dey; but on tha spoil laid dey not their hand.
On dat day tha number of dose dat were killed in Shushan tha palace was brought before tha king.

N tha king said 2 Esther tha queen, tha Jews have killed N destroyed five hundred men in Shushan tha palace, N tha ten sons of Haman; what have dey done in tha rest of tha king’s provinces? now what is ur petition? N it will be granted u: or what is ur request further? N it will be done.
Then said Esther, If it please tha king, let it be granted 2 tha Jews which r in Shushan 2 do 2 morrow also according 2 dis day’s decree, N let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon tha gallows.
N tha king commanded it so 2 be done: N tha decree was given at Shushan; N dey hanged Haman’s ten sons.
4 tha Jews dat were in Shushan gathered themselves together on tha fourteenth day also of tha month Adar, N killed three hundred men at Shushan; but on tha prey dey laid not their hand.

But tha other Jews dat were in tha king’s provinces gathered themselves together, N stood 4 their lives, N had rest from their opps, N killed of their opps seventy N five thousand, but dey laid not their hands on tha prey,
On tha thirteenth day of tha month Adar; N on tha fourteenth day of tha same rested dey, N made it a day of feasting N gladness.
But tha Jews dat were at Shushan assembled together on tha thirteenth day of it, N on tha fourteenth of it; N on tha fifteenth day of tha same dey rested, N made it a day of feasting N gladness.
Therefore tha Jews of tha villages, dat lived in tha unwalled towns, made tha fourteenth day of tha month Adar a day of gladness N feasting, N a good day, N of sending portions one 2 another.
N Mordecai wrote dese things, N sent letters 2 all tha Jews dat were in all tha provinces of tha king Ahasuerus, both nigh N far,
2 stablish dis among ’em, dat dey should keep tha fourteenth day of tha month Adar, N tha fifteenth day of tha same, yearly,

As tha days in which tha Jews rested from their opps, N tha month which was turned 2 ’em from sorrow 2 joy, N from mournin in2 a good day: dat dey should make ’em days of feasting N joy, N of sending portions one 2 another, N gifts 2 tha poor.
N tha Jews undertook 2 do as dey had begun, N as Mordecai had written 2 ’em;
Because Haman tha son of Hammedatha, tha Agagite, tha opp of all tha Jews, had devised against tha Jews 2 destroy ’em, N had cast Pur, dat is, tha lot, 2 consume ’em, N 2 destroy ’em;

But when Esther came before tha king, he commanded by letters dat his wicked device, which he devised against tha Jews, should return upon his own head, N dat he N his sons should be hanged on tha gallows.
So dey called dese days Purim after tha name of Pur. Therefore 4 all tha words of dis letter, N of dat which dey had seen concerning dis matter, N which had come 2 ’em,

Tha Jews ordained, N took upon ’em, N upon their seed, N upon all such as joined themselves 2 ’em, so as it should not fail, dat dey would keep dese two days according 2 their writing, N according 2 their appointed time every year;

N dat dese days should be remembered N kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, N every city; N dat dese days of Purim should not fail from among tha Jews, nor tha memorial of ’em perish from their seed.
Then Esther tha queen, tha daughter of Abihail, N Mordecai tha Jew, wrote wit all authority, 2 confirm dis second letter of Purim.
N he sent tha letters 2 all tha Jews, 2 tha hundred twenty N seven provinces of tha kingdom of Ahasuerus, wit words of peace N truth,

2 confirm dese days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai tha Jew N Esther tha queen had enjoined ’em, N as dey had decreed 4 themselves N 4 their seed, tha matters of tha fastings N their cry.
